acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Guest Host Sean Cole gets some scary news about his health, and decides to quit smoking.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Sean Cole attempts to kick his 35 year-long smoking habit, using a book that’s said to have helped millions of people to quit.
acts.title: The Straw That Broke Joe Camel's Back. / Can I Still Be a Joker and a Midnight Toker? / The Unbearable Lighterlessness of Being.

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc:
Someone writes into the advice column Dear Sugar to ask whether or not they should quit a relationship, and gets a strange but very persuasive response.
An adaptation of some of Cheryl Strayed’s columns is now streaming on Hulu. It’s called Tiny Beautiful Things.
acts.credits: By Cheryl Strayed; Produced by Diane Wu
acts.title: A Spoonful of Sugar

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Even people who vehemently disagreed with Heider Garcia wanted him to stay in his job. But then something happened that made staying impossible. Zoe Chace reports.
acts.title: Tender Resignation
